segments.text: A runner finds a huge suitcase hidden in tall grass. Then a man steps out of the woods.
This one's from Reddit, so nobody's checked it. Let's go look.
The runner uses this forest trail all the time. Today, there's a suitcase. They step closer.
A man jumps out, right between them and the case. He never touches it. He says he's running {50|fifty} kilometres.
Look at his feet. Boots. Nobody runs {50|fifty} kilometres in boots.
The runner sees it too, and gets out of there fast.
For the next two days, police search those trails for the body of a missing person.
The runner has to show them exactly where the suitcase had been.
Lost luggage? Or something he didn't want found? Nobody knows.
So what was in it? Tell me your theory in the comments. This case stays open.
